Container.Name: deepseek-harness-dind
Container.Overview: Private privileged Docker-in-Docker daemon for the DeepSeek Harness desktop. Join only the user-created dsh-dind bridge; the desktop resolves this fixed container name through Docker DNS. Do not attach DinD to dsh-proxy. Port 2375 is not published to the Unraid host.

Config.Name: Docker data
Config.Description: Persistent DinD image, container, and volume data.

Config.Name: Disable DinD TLS
Config.Description: Empty value enables the private TCP endpoint on port 2375 for the desktop on dsh-dind. Do not publish this port.
